nominal: reuse the exact100 native training-time evaluation records at each milestone; never rerun nominal and select a result
perturbations: frozen native stochastic actors and margin heads; no adaptation; same four conditions fixed before formal outcomes
lateral_sign_rule: even episode index negative,odd positive;50 per side
lateral_axis: horizontal unit vector perpendicular to each sampled start-to-goal line; exactly world_x on the original v2 task
layout_admissibility: v3 shift is applied before the shared safe-start and safe-goal reset checks; accepted layouts can differ between conditions,never between methods; save and compare actual poses
layout_validity: one shared500-layout physical path proof,not repeated per policy/checkpoint; a failed proof is visible and does not cause failed learned episodes to be removed
